# VOLGA Fizioterapi & Rehabilitim

Physiotherapy and rehabilitation clinic in Durrës (Currila), Albania.
Albanian, English, Italian and Russian speaking. Appointment-based.

## Services
Manual therapy, sports rehabilitation, post-operative recovery, postural
correction, pain management (back/neck), mobility training, lymphatic drainage,
cupping, therapeutic exercises, plus aesthetic/regenerative treatments (PRP,
mesotherapy). Advanced equipment: Shock Wave, Human Tecar (HCR 1002), Laser,
Magnetotherapy (Storz), Ultrasound, TENS.

## Hours
Monday to Saturday, 09:00-20:00. Sunday closed.
